description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Change Machinery Mode II (Fire, Lightning, Poison)], [Awoken Machine Mania], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Affable King Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Machine Mania
description.text: Machinist abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Trinity Crossbow after using Machinist abilities

description.name: Trinity Crossbow
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (0.70 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Change Machinery Mode II (Fire, Lightning, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] after using a Fire/Lightning/Poison ability

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Affable King Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, Machinist abilities deal 10/20/30% more damage after casting 1/2/3+ Machinist abilities
